learning_outcomes.text: have basic knowledge and skills in a selected subfield of computer science
know practical concepts and applications in the selected subfield of computer science
are able to apply scientific working methods to independently solve problems and communicate the solution
have acquired competencies preferably from the field of Technical Computer Science

assessment_methods.method: Weekly exercise assignments (at least 50% of points)
Oral presentation of solutions to at least two exercise assignments
Written exam or oral exam (individual exam)

assessment_rules: Grading is done with 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the B.Sc. Computer Science degree program. To acquire credit points, at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercise assignments must be achieved, and the solution of at least two exercise assignments must be presented orally. The examination performance is a written exam or an individual oral exam.
